text:
deploy-bot: IMAGE PUBLISH STARTED — attempting push to registry.redwood.ai
deploy-bot: env=canary image=registry.redwood.ai/inference/canary:2026-03-19-7f3a2 commit=7f3a2d4
deploy-bot: step=upload_blob chunk=3/12 status=504 Gateway Time-out error=ERR_BLOB_TTL_EXPIRED

maria: saw the alert. same LB flakiness we had yesterday? large layers time out during multipart blob uploads.

deploy-bot: retry 1 -> backoff 4s
deploy-bot: retry 2 -> backoff 8s, still 504 on chunk upload, manifest push not attempted yet

jonathan: can we reduce chunk size or switch to resumable upload? last time switching to 4MB chunks helped for big layers.

li: quick note — registry ingress logs show bursts of 502/504 around 18:12–18:14Z. filing a metric alert. `kubectl -n infra logs registry-ingress-6f8b -c proxy | grep 18:12`

maria: suggestion: defer final manifest push and keep the tag blocked from promotion until ops confirms blob integrity. don't promote partial images.

deploy-bot: state=DEFERRED background_retry_interval=30s max_background_retries=120
deploy-bot: recommendation=pin previous stable image for canary until push completes -> pin=v3.2.1 digest=sha256:9f8e7d...

katie: holding canary rollout. I'll update the change window and add a note to release notes: "canary image push delayed due to registry timeouts; pinning v3.2.1 until resolved."

jonathan: if background retries fail, ops can push the manifest from a different zone/host: `skopeo copy docker://local/inference@sha256:... docker://registry.redwood.ai/inference:canary-2026-03-19` — works as emergency path.

deploy-bot: background job progress: attempt=5/120 last_error=504 next_retry_in=00:00:30

li: raising a short maintenance on the registry proxy to drain active connections and roll the proxy (will be <5m). planning at 18:30Z. will post before the restart.

maria: thanks — that should clear the TTL expiries. when proxy is up, we should see manifest push succeed quickly.

deploy-bot: BACKGROUND PUSH: manifest upload succeeded
deploy-bot: final_status=uploaded manifest_digest=sha256:abcd1234ef567890cafebabe00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff00112233
deploy-bot: note=tag not auto-promoted due to `canary-block` policy; manual promote required

katie: ack. I'm keeping the canary blocked until we do quick smoke tests. anyone want to run smoke now?

jonathan: running smoke suite now against the pushed image. will report failures in ~5m.

maria: ops follow-up: please check registry metrics and network egress during the push window and add the proxy restart to postmortem if similar bursts recur.

deploy-bot: manual_action: to promote image run `/promote-image registry.redwood.ai/inference@sha256:abcd1234ef56 --env canary` — requires two approvals.

jonathan: smoke looks clean — basic generation and embedding endpoints OK. no obvious regressions.

katie: ok let's keep canary blocked for 15 more minutes, then we can promote if no issues. leaving a :hourglass_flowing_sand: reaction on the thread."
